## Meet NEKO
## What do you play today?
Whether you’re a beginner, an experienced player or a professional musician, NEKO meets you where you are and gives you more to explore as you grow.
## NEKO in details

This project is promoted by Jellop, the ad tech power behind the best Kickstarters with 3,500+ successful Kickstarter projects with over $1B raised between them.
risks: Neko isn't a render. Our first engineering prototype ran in December 2025. Our first design-validation unit followed in January 2026, and we’re already on the second design iteration. The bill of materials is locked, the enclosure is already in production with our manufacturing partner, and even the display is custom-made for NEKO. Memory costs are our biggest external risk and they’re rising industry-wide for reasons far beyond music gear. We’ve already locked and quoted our BOM, secured pricing with manufacturing partners, and designed our own mainboard so no single vendor controls our schedule. If memory costs rise further, we absorb the difference. Your pledge price and NEKO specs stay the same. Software. Everything shown in this campaign runs on the device today. Anything planned is labelled as planned, with no date attached. Stretch goals extend the software – they don't move the ship date. Manufacturing is the hard part: tooling, production yield, certification, and scaling from prototypes to thousands of consistent units. That’s why shipping starts in April 2027. The time between Kickstarter and delivery isn’t empty space, it’s the room a first production run actually needs to be done right.

faq.q: Can I use NEKO with a normal guitar cable?
faq.a: Absolutely! NEKO can be used wirelessly or wired, depending on your setup and mood.

faq.q: Can I use headphones? Does NEKO have a speaker?
faq.a: Actually both! Plug in your headphones or use NEKO’s built-in speaker, it’s totally up to you.

faq.q: How long does the battery last?
faq.a: NEKO is designed up to 6 hours of active play and wireless jacks can perform up to 3 hours.
NEKO comes with 16 GB of onboard storage. You can extend it with the cloud storage, by getting a paid-plan
Time Machine keeps track of your playing so you can go back, find a moment, listen to it again, save it, reamp it, and keep working from there.

faq.q: Can I use NEKO live on stage?
faq.a: Yes. NEKO was never designed to live permanently on a desk. Connect it to an amp, mixer, or PA, use your saved sounds and presets, and take the same compact setup from home to rehearsal to stage.
It’s on the roadmap and currently planned as a Kickstarter stretch goal.

faq.q: Do I need an internet connection to work with NEKO?
faq.a: NEKO can work completely independently without an internet connection. Its core functions run directly on the device, so you can play, shape your sound, record, use Time Machine, practice, and access local tools wherever you are.

No, NEKO is a fully functioning device. The core features presented on this page are already working as intended, and the product design and form factor are locked.

Kickstarter is not where we start figuring NEKO out. It is what helps us move into final assembly and production at scale.

The only additions may come from the Stretch Goals (new features we’ll develop if the campaign reaches the corresponding funding milestones).

faq.q: Do you ship outside the US?
faq.a: Yes, we do! Please explore the "Shipping rates" section for details.

faq.q: Can I back without a reward?
faq.a: Yes! You can always pledge without choosing a reward if you’d just like to support the project.

faq.q: What's the best way to contact the NEKO team?
faq.a: You can send us a direct message via Kickstarter, we will try to get back to you within 24 hours.

First, you’ll need to login to your Kickstarter account. If you don’t have one, you can sign up here: https://www.kickstarter.com/signup

After logging in:
1. Go to The Freeman Codex's project page and click the green “Back this project” button to the right of the main image. Or, you can scroll down to select a reward tier. If a reward tier is no longer available it won’t be possible to select it and this will move to the bottom of the rewards column.
2. On the next page, you will have a chance…

faq.q: What forms of payment can I use to make a pledge?
faq.a:
You can use a debit or credit card associated with Visa, Discover, JCB, MasterCard, UnionPay, or American Express. At this time, Discover, UnionPay, and JCB cards are only accepted for US-based projects. Please, note: Kickstarter does not currently accept Maestro, Visa Electron, Discover, or UnionPay. Additionally, they do not support PayPal.

If you will be using a prepaid credit card, please make sure that the card has a value of at least $1 USD (or the equivalent in your local currency) more…

faq.q: How/when do I provide shipping details?
faq.a: After the Kickstarter campaign ends and is successfully funded, we will send you a link to our Pledge Manager. There, you will be able to confirm your reward, add any available extras, pay for shipping if needed, and provide your shipping address. Kickstarter does not collect or store your shipping information at checkout.

updates.title: NEKO HITS $100K IN LESS THAN 24 HOURS
updates.text:
What an energy! More than 400 backers have already joined us on Kickstarter. We’re incredibly happy to welcome every one of you and say a huge thank you for supporting NEKO.
In less than an hour after launch, we reached our funding goal. And now, before the first 24 hours are even over, our first Stretch Goal has already been unlocked:
And this is just the first one.
We’ve got more stretch goals, more ideas we’d love to bring to NEKO.
Thank you for being here this early, for backing us, sharing the project, sending questions, and generally making launch day feel a little unreal.
